title: Does System Prompt Framing at Inference Time (Not Training) Reduce Misalignment Rates?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct practical value: if inference-time prompts can suppress misalignment, it is a cheap and immediately deployable patch. If not, it strengthens the case for training-time interventions. Clear actionable outcome.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Only requires running inference on an already-misaligned model with different system prompts. No finetuning needed (can use pre-trained misaligned models from the repo). Prompt-level manipulation is highly accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: No training required, just inference with 4 system prompt variants on the standard evaluation set. Single deliverable: comparison table of misalignment rates by prompt condition. Easily completable in well under 30 hours.
